This is how I set up the TimePicker:


```
  println("Setup: hour ${item.hour} : minute ${item.minute}")
  val state = rememberAdaptiveTimePickerState(
    initialHour = item.hour,
    initialMinute = item.minute
  )

  LaunchedEffect(state.hour, state.minute) {
    println("minute: ${state.minute}")
    println("hour: ${state.hour}")
    setMinute(state.minute)
    setHour(state.hour)
  }

```
It's working fine on Android, but on iOS it switches immediately between minute and hour.

```
Setup: hour 19 : minute 0
minute: 19
hour: 0
```

Edit 1:
After debugging, I commented the `LaunchedEffect(state.hour, state.minute) `.  I saw that the value had switched after set to the TimePicker.  So the Picker show `00:19` not `19:00`

This is how I set up the TimePicker:


```
  println("Setup: hour ${item.hour} : minute ${item.minute}")
  val state = rememberAdaptiveTimePickerState(
    initialHour = item.hour,
    initialMinute = item.minute
  )

  LaunchedEffect(state.hour, state.minute) {
    println("minute: ${state.minute}")
    println("hour: ${state.hour}")
    setMinute(state.minute)
    setHour(state.hour)
  }

```
It's working fine on Android, but on iOS it switches immediately minute and hour.

```
Setup: hour 19 : minute 0
minute: 19
hour: 0
```
